title: Thirty days to report after a transfer of ownership or change of Manager of Record
subtopic: Reporting after a transfer of ownership
rule_summary: A Manager of Record of a STERILE COMPOUNDING PHARMACY, COMPLEX NON-STERILE COMPOUNDING PHARMACY or INSTITUTIONAL STERILE COMPOUNDING PHARMACY shall, ANNUALLY and WITHIN 30 DAYS AFTER ANY TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP OR CHANGE IN CORPORATE OFFICERS, MANAGEMENT PERSONNEL OR MANAGER OF RECORD, file a report containing the information disclosed under 247 CMR 20.06(6)(a), which is the location, name and title of all principal managers and the name and Massachusetts license number of the designated Manager of Record. A NON-RESIDENT PHARMACY shall submit the information its designated pharmacist in charge owes under 247 CMR 20.07(2) on an ANNUAL basis and WITHIN 30 DAYS after any transfer of ownership or change in corporate officers, management personnel or Manager of Record.
exam_relevance: Tests a reporting clock that runs after a change of owner or Manager of Record has taken effect, is counted in 30 days rather than 14, and reaches compounding pharmacies and non-resident pharmacies rather than every licensee.

common_confusions: The 30-day report is additional to, not a substitute for, the 14-calendar-day notice of a change of Manager of Record under 247 CMR 20.05.
The duty is type-specific: 247 CMR 20.06(6)(e) reaches compounding pharmacies and 247 CMR 20.07(2) reaches non-resident pharmacies.
The trigger is wider than a change of owner, since a change in corporate officers or management personnel also starts the 30 days.
verification_notes: Read in the current official text of 247 CMR 20.00: Reporting published at mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
